title: RT69004: Rubber Laboratory
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Influence of nature and loading of filler on the properties of rubber, design
of rubber compounds with given specifications. Study of the properties of the
blends and thermoplastic elastomer from rubber and plastics. Effects of ageing,
design of thermoplastic elastomer with required properties. Reverse engineering
by IR, TGA and chemical; analyses and formulae reconstruction of a supplied
vulcanizate; Design and testing of an oil seal with a given set of properties.
Capillary rheometer study of black filled NR and SBR. Calculation of the shear
stress at the wall of the two-roll mill cylinders; Determination of limiting
oxygen index of a given vulcanizate and design of a flame resistant compound;
Design and testing of an O-mount with specific compressive stiffness,
Preparation of contact adhesive and study of the fabric to fabric and wood to
wood adhesion; Study of the tack and effect of fillers on tack, adhesion
between NR and aluminium; Preparation of products like rubber ball, Howai
Chappal, Plastic bottle cap; Dynamic mechanical and electrical properties.
